claims: The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place on Monday, April 13, 2026.
The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place at 7 p.m. ET.
The 2026 WNBA Draft is held at The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City.
The 2026 WNBA Draft has live coverage on ESPN.
Coverage of the 2026 WNBA Draft begins with the "WNBA Draft Orange Carpet Show" at 5:30 p.m. ET on ESPN2.
The 2026 WNBA Draft consists of three rounds.
The 2026 WNBA Draft features coverage of new expansion teams.
The first pick of the 2026 WNBA Draft is selected by the Dallas Wings.
The 2026 WNBA Draft TV/Streaming is on ESPN (U.S.).
